سِرْيَاحٌ : see سُرُحٌ. ―
-b2- Also Tall; (S, K;) as an epithet applied to a man. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And Locusts, or the locust. (S, O, K, TA. [In the CK, and in my MS. copy of the K, الجَوادُ is erroneously put for الجَرَادُ.]) And أُمُّ سِرْيَاحٍ The female locust: (Aboo-'Amr Ez-Záhid, IB.) and the name of A certain woman, (S, K,) in one instance only. (Aboo-'Amr Ez-Záhid, IB.) ―
-b2- السِّرْيَاحُ, (K,) or سِرْيَاحٌ, (O,) is the name of A certain dog. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
